explanation: The nonce check in verify rejects tokens whose nonce is already in seen. Removing it would let a token be replayed. #123 is the related issue.
Call ensure_key_salt before initializing KeyManager. If salt setup fails, abort startup instead of creating the manager.
Keep topN at or below maxSimpleTopN before allocating buf. That bound is meant to keep the resulting slice at or below 1 MiB.
unsure: The comment does not show how maxSimpleTopN accounts for the size of Chunk.

explanation: When meta.abi_version is missing, the map expression must leave abi as None. Treating a missing value as the current ABI would be unsafe. #1784 is the related issue.
TLP reads /etc/tlp.conf after files matching /etc/tlp.d/*.conf, so a value in /etc/tlp.conf overrides the drop-in written at /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf.

This configuration requires TLP version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV name profile suffixes; the set_key call sets the battery value. Leave the _AC value unset so GNOME's Performance toggle continues to work.
On a JsonException, return null instead of throwing. The caller interprets that parse failure and logs a warning.
When AllowedTools is set, remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args. That flag bypasses the restrictions supplied by --allowedTools, so leaving it in would defeat the tool allowlist.
The verdict table for thunk_is_dead is at the is_definitely_dead_code symbol in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs. Consult it to understand the possible dead-code results.
unsure: The comment does not describe the table or its verdicts.

explanation: Replace the hard-coded repos_skipped value with a count derived from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 tracks that work.
index.regex_query uses a linear-time DFA for the pattern, so this query does not incur regex backtracking costs.
Keep the token-family table schema in sync with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py when changing this CREATE TABLE statement.
The vendor's batch API accepts at most 500 items, so MAX_BATCH is 500. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor API documentation.

Keep these Go Status values in sync with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Because iota assigns integers by position, reordering Pending, Running or Done would change the meaning of already stored integers. #88 is the related issue.
Keep tenant_id first and created_at second in this index. That column order matches the orders_by_tenant query.
TList must keep FCount no greater than Length(FItems) when adding an item. Grow is the operation responsible for preserving that capacity invariant.
Call _flush before closing _sink. Closing drops _buf, so reversing the calls could lose buffered data.
userPath comes from a request. Resolve it under workspaceRoot and reject paths containing .. that escape that root, so the request cannot access paths outside the workspace.
unsure: The shown resolve-and-normalize line does not itself show the escape check.

explanation: Drain the ring before freeing buf. If buf is freed first, the interrupt handler may still access it and cause a use-after-free. #2201 is the related issue.

Reserve space for n items before appending so allocation happens once. Growth during push_back accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE into dbo.Accounts; without it, concurrent upserts can race. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the MERGE documentation.
The audit operation uses an autonomous transaction so its row survives even if the caller rolls back its own transaction.

For this SQLite schema change, rebuild the table as leases_new because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the required constraints. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant ALTER TABLE documentation section.
Poll every five seconds with done.wait(5) because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this code would need for change detection.
Keep the awaited run calls in a for...of loop. Using await inside forEach would let errors escape the surrounding try/catch.
A decoded Vec<u8> frame must have length at most MAX_FRAME. read_frame enforces this by rejecting larger frames.
Register drainHook before pool.start(). The hook drains the pool on SIGTERM, so it must already be installed when the pool starts.
Move the hard-coded backoff retry policy into configuration. This task is complete when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of allowed lease state transitions for the Active, Released and Stale values in this enum.
Pass the token to tool login through stdin, never as a command-line argument. Other users can see arguments through ps.
Create app_reader before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 assumes that role already exists.
Make on_event idempotent because Stripe may retry the same webhook for three days. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook retry documentation.
Compare sig and expected with constant-time hmac.Equal. Using == for MAC comparison could reveal information through timing differences.
Build CodeGraph from facts once per index, at O(edges) cost. Do not rebuild it for each query.
TCustomerRec's packed layout is stored in .dat files. Changing that layout would break existing saved files unless FILE_VERSION is bumped to distinguish the new format.
Keep MSG_MAX in this header synchronized with MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h; change both constants together.
After authMiddleware runs, session.userId must be non-null when this handler executes.
Synchronize access to cache because the check followed by put must be one atomic operation. A ConcurrentHashMap alone would not make that two-step sequence atomic.
raw is a user-supplied repository alias. Validate it against the registry before joining it into a path to prevent unsafe path construction. #1996 is the related issue.
Every inserted Payment Amount must be nonnegative. Represent a refund as a separate row whose Kind is 'R', rather than as a negative Amount.
Set stop_ before joining worker_. Otherwise the worker may keep running and join() may block forever.

The GitHub API limit cited here is 5,000 requests per hour per token. The limiter's 720 ms interval corresponds to that average rate. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the REST API rate-limit documentation.
Stop the cidx service before installing its replacement binary. Replacing a binary while it runs can fail with 'Text file busy'.
Do not share _lease across jobs. A shared CredentialLease could expose one user's credentials to another user's job. #77 is the related issue.
Keep len(ids) at or below 999 when building this DELETE statement, because each id uses a SQLite bound variable and the comment assumes a 999-variable limit per statement.
If cgroup.create(limit) fails, log the error and let the job continue. A bad memory estimate should degrade containment rather than abort the job.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route. #530 tracks that task.
doc:adr-007#session-model points to the session-model section of ADR 007, which explains why SessionRegistry keeps sessions per tab.
This partial index covers only leases whose released_at is NULL, matching active-lease lookups by credential_id. The comment reports those lookups as 30 times faster with this index.
Keep the values in EVENT_TYPES synchronized with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and the event definitions in docs/events.md.
